ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Dissolved oxygen DO refers to the content of oxygen dissolved in water and is an important indicator for measuring water quality. Biochemical oxygen demand BOD is the amount of oxygen that microorganisms need to consume when decomposing organic matter in water; it is used to monitor the pollution condition of organic matter in a water body. The following figure shows the concentration change curves of dissolved oxygen and biochemical oxygen demand in the water of a certain river from river section M to river section Q. <image1> According to the diagram, which river section is most likely to cause fish death?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Horizontally, the figure represents the river from river sections M, N, O, P to Q, and the arrow shows the direction of pollution or water flow; vertically it represents concentration, with "large" at the top and "small" at the bottom. In the figure there are two change curves, DO and BOD, among which the DO curve is relatively high in section M, drops to the lowest near river section O after changing downstream, and then gradually rises again toward P and Q. Then reason: Fish survival depends most on dissolved oxygen in the water; the lower the DO, the more oxygen-deficient the water body is, and the more likely it is to cause fish death. According to the diagram, the position where DO is lowest is near river section O, so the river section most likely to cause fish death is river section O.

method.method_draft: 读取图中各河段的DO变化曲线，比较M至Q各段的DO高低。图上DO在O河段附近最低，因此该处水体最缺氧。根据鱼类最容易在溶解氧最低处死亡，答案为O河段。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中横向表示河流由M、N、O、P到Q河段，箭头显示污染或水流方向；纵向表示浓度，上方为“大”、下方为“小”。图中有DO和BOD两条变化曲线，其中DO曲线在M段较高，向下游变化后在O河段附近降到最低，之后到P、Q方向又逐渐回升。
再推理：鱼类生存最依赖水中的溶解氧，DO越低，水体越缺氧，越容易导致鱼类死亡。根据图示DO最低的位置在O河段附近，所以最容易导致鱼类死亡的是O河段。

raw_record.original_question:
溶解氧DO是指溶解于水中的氧的含量，是衡量水质的重要指标。生化需氧量BOD是微生物分解水中的有机物体时需要消耗氧的数量，它用于监测水体有机物的污染状况。下图为某河由M河段至Q河段水中溶解氧和生化需氧量浓度变化曲线。

<image1>

根据图示，最容易导致鱼类死亡的是哪个河段？
